q: Read the fall time for 6 cm blades.
Longer blades, longer fall time, up to about 10 cm; then it levels off (or drops slightly).
Calculate the mean speed of fall for 8 cm blades.
The error bars get longer for long blades. Suggest why, and what this means for the 10 and 12 cm results.
Long blades flop and wobble, so drops vary more. The bars overlap, so we cannot say 12 cm is really worse than 10 cm.
